conversion.method: Faithful conversion from official Piper X URDF / Xacro to MuJoCo MJCF
conversion.joint_conventions: Six revolute joints matching MDH kinematics from pyAgxArm constants; two symmetric slide joints for parallel gripper
conversion.collision_approximation: Official visual meshes retained. Concave gripper collision meshes replaced by primitive finger arms and pads to avoid convex-hull wedging; see grasp-debug.json for dimensions and dynamic grasp evidence.
conversion.actuation: Position servos with bounded target speed and acceleration; gravity and rigid-body contact advance objects. No weld, adhesion, or object teleport in manipulation skills.
conversion.validation_scope: Simulation only. This conversion and simplified contact geometry have not been validated on physical hardware.
